theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gt_bounded_transfer_of_lintegral_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [Nonempty X] (m : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) (D Z : Set X) (S : Set Y) (φ : Y → X) (s : X → ℝ) (a c : ℝ), MeasurableSet D → MeasurableSet Z → Measurable φ → m D ≠ ∞ → ν S ≠ ∞ → m Z ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ c → (∀ v, 0 ≤ s v) → IntegrableOn s D m → (∀ h : X → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable h → (∫⁻ v in D \ Z, h v ∂m) ≤ (∫⁻ y in S, h (φ y) ∂ν) ∧ (∫⁻ y in S, h (φ y) ∂ν) ≤ ∫⁻ v in D \ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c * s v) * h v ∂m) → (∀ (g : X → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, 0 ≤ g v) → (∀ v, g v ≤ G) → (∫⁻ v in D, ENNReal.ofReal (g v) ∂m) ≤ (∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (g (φ y)) ∂ν) + ENNReal.ofReal (G * a)) ∧ ∀ (g : X → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ v, |g v| ≤ G) → |(∫ v in D, g v ∂m) - (∫ y in S, g (φ y) ∂ν)| ≤ G * (a + c * (∫ v in D, s v ∂m))
